purpose: Render a review-first approval cockpit for the employer deliverable packet, allowing the operator to view the audit and choose review_only, proceed, or deny without silently submitting externally.

button_model.proceed_button: Records approval_for_submission_handoff only. It does not send externally unless a future approved live connector exists.
button_model.deny_button: Records denied_by_operator and blocks submission handoff.
button_model.review_only_button: Displays audit and keeps decision pending.
